content.value_statement: Tilt issues can hide behind pending resources, stale logs, and Docker Compose health gaps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through targeted status checks, logs, and Tiltfile patterns.
actual_capabilities: Checks UIResource runtimeStatus, updateStatus, and buildHistory errors with Tilt and jq patterns.
Identifies Docker Compose healthStatus problems missed by basic Tilt status checks.
Uses Tilt log filters, tails, JSON output, and search patterns for diagnosis.
Explains Tiltfile resources for local_resource, docker_build, k8s_yaml, k8s_resource, and docker_compose.
Guides Tilt lifecycle commands, waits, triggers, custom ports, and zmx session startup.
limitations: Requires Tilt and related command-line tools to be installed in the user environment.
Cannot inspect live resources without access to the active local Tilt instance.
Lifecycle commands can change local development resources when the user runs them.
Does not replace official Tilt documentation for advanced or version-specific behavior.

use_cases.title: Investigate Failed Local Deployments
use_cases.description: Find errored Tilt resources, review buildHistory messages, and separate real failures from pending updates.

use_cases.title: Review Docker Compose Health
use_cases.description: Detect unhealthy Compose services that can look healthy in basic Tilt runtime and update fields.

use_cases.title: Improve Tiltfile Workflows
use_cases.description: Use resource dependencies, live update steps, triggers, labels, links, and configuration patterns effectively.

prompt_templates.title: Check Tilt Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Tilt skill to check resource health. Start with errors, then pending resources, then Docker Compose health.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Resource Logs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Tilt skill to inspect logs for the api resource from the last five minutes. Summarize likely failure causes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Tiltfile Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Tiltfile API guidance to review my resource dependencies, live update order, and trigger mode choices.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Compose Health Drift
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Tilt skill to compare runtime status, update status, Compose health, and recent logs. Recommend the next investigation step.

output_examples.input: Check why my Tilt dashboard shows a red Compose service.
output_examples.output: The likely issue is Docker Compose health, not the Tilt runtime field. Review the service health status and recent probe output first.

output_examples.input: Summarize the state of all Tilt resources.
output: One resource has a recent build error that should be investigated before declaring the environment healthy.

output_examples.input: Review my Tiltfile live update section.
output_examples.output: Move full rebuild triggers before sync steps. Keep run steps after sync so container commands execute against current files.

best_practices: Check explicit error states before reviewing pending or in-progress resources.
Re-poll resources before declaring success when a build is still in progress.
Use structured Tilt output when you need reliable status parsing.
anti_patterns: Do not restart Tilt for normal code, manifest, or Tiltfile changes.
Do not rely only on runtimeStatus for Docker Compose health checks.
Do not treat human-readable describe output as stable machine-readable data.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps diagnose Tilt resource health, logs, Docker Compose status, and Tiltfile behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides command guidance that the user or agent must choose to run.

faq.question: Can it work with non-default Tilt ports?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance includes using a custom Tilt API port when the default port is not active.

faq.question: Can it debug Docker Compose health checks?
faq.answer: Yes. It calls out Compose healthStatus because basic runtime and update fields can miss unhealthy containers.

faq.question: Can it help write Tiltfiles?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes references for resources, dependencies, live update, configuration, extensions, and file operations.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
